CLEMENT PROJECTS SOLUTION

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Mining equipment.
Engineering. Construction. Agriculture.

Clement Projects Solution is a privately owned company based in Phalaborwa, specialising in mining equipment supplies, engineering solutions, construction services and agricultural projects. We are committed to providing reliable, cost-effective and technically sound solutions to the mining, minerals processing, water treatment, infrastructure and construction industries. Our services also include agricultural work across our region.

HOW WE DELIVER

How We Deliver

We match people, planning and quality controls to each project’s scope and site requirements.

01

Quality management

We plan quality controls around the scope and complexity of each project.

  • Work to client specifications and applicable technical standards
  • Select suitable materials and qualified personnel
  • Inspect work, address defects and document handover
02

Health, safety & environment

We plan for safe working conditions and responsible environmental management on site.

  • Site-specific safety plans, induction and risk assessments
  • Protective equipment, safe equipment handling and incident reporting
  • Waste management, housekeeping and subcontractor safety monitoring
03

Local recruitment & skills development

Where feasible, we recruit from communities around project sites and create opportunities for youth, women, people with disabilities and previously disadvantaged individuals.

  • On-the-job training and mentorship
  • Technical, safety and supervisory skills development
  • Learnerships and internships where feasible
04

Small business development & subcontracting

We involve small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs) in civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing and supply work where the project scope allows.

  • Assess capability, price, capacity and compliance
  • Define scope, responsibilities and payment terms in written agreements
  • Monitor quality and safety and offer technical guidance where practical

OUR LEADERSHIP

Our Leadership

Shai Clement

FOUNDER, CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER & DIRECTOR

Mr Shai Clement is the Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Director of Clement Projects Solution (Pty) Ltd, a privately owned company specialising in mining equipment supplies, engineering solutions, construction services and agricultural projects. He established the company with a passion for construction and engineering, an entrepreneurial vision and a commitment to excellence.

His objective is to deliver reliable, innovative and quality-driven solutions to clients across mining, industrial, construction and related sectors. His practical industry knowledge and business leadership support CPS in meeting client requirements and industry expectations.

Education and experience

Mr Clement holds a National Certificate in Construction Contracting (Level 2) and a Level 3 qualification in Engineering Related Design (Fitting and Turning). These qualifications provide a foundation in construction contracting, engineering design, mechanical principles, technical operations and management.

Leadership approach and vision

His leadership philosophy is built on professionalism, accountability, quality service delivery, customer satisfaction and strong working relationships with clients, suppliers and business partners. He provides strategic direction, oversees business operations, develops client and supplier relationships, and drives the company’s growth and long-term sustainability.

Mr Clement’s vision is to position CPS as a preferred and trusted service provider in mining, engineering and construction, recognised for technical capability, dependable service, innovation and customer satisfaction. Through visionary leadership, continuous improvement and meaningful community involvement, he is committed to building a sustainable business that creates economic opportunities, supports local development and contributes positively to the industries and communities it serves.

Under his leadership, CPS has supported the Mashishimale Fun Walk by donating water bottles and sponsored the Mashishimale Heritage Event. The events are featured in the Community Development section.

LOCAL COMMITMENT

Community Development

Clement Projects Solution contributed water bottles to support participants at the Mashishimale Fun Walk and sponsored the Mashishimale Heritage Event. These initiatives support local cultural activities, community engagement and social development.
